lessonTitle: Difference between data, observation, insight and implication

slides.title: Confusing Four Layers Weakens Every Report
bullets: Data, observation, insight and implication form a layered hierarchy
Confusing them is the most common cause of weak field reporting
Knowing where each layer ends lets an MSL build something strategic

slides.title: Data Is Raw and Uninterpreted
bullets: A number, fact or directly recorded statement, nothing more
Example: three physicians this quarter asked about elderly dosing
Verifiable, but inert until something is done with it

slides.title: Observation Notices the Pattern
bullets: A first layer of pattern recognition across the data
Example: more physicians raised this question than in prior quarters
Still does not explain why the pattern exists

slides.title: Insight Reasons Through the Why
bullets: Genuine understanding, informed by scientific knowledge and field context
Example: uncertainty stems from poorly communicated real-world safety data
Explains the underlying why, not just a restatement of the pattern

slides.title: Implication Names the Actionable Consequence
bullets: The specific, actionable so-what the insight points toward
Example: a targeted education initiative and a real-world evidence sub-analysis
Lets someone inside the organisation decide whether and how to act

slides.title: Each Layer Needs the One Below It
bullets: Implication without real insight is a recommendation dressed as analysis
Insight without solid data and observation is speculation
Skipping a layer produces weak output at the next one

slides.title: Move Through All Four Layers Deliberately
bullets: Don't jump from one conversation straight to a sweeping implication
Consciously work up through data, observation, insight, implication
This discipline is what capture, writing and bias lessons protect

takeaway.title: Data, observation, insight and implication build on each other in strict order
bullets: Data is raw, observation notices a pattern, insight explains why
Implication is the concrete so-what that enables a decision
Skipping a layer turns analysis into speculation or an unsupported recommendation
